title: 《老板来》

source.subject: 老板

hook: 老板以最真诚、最不协调的方式，试图熬过眼前这场荒谬危机。
character_bible: an original office archetype with an asymmetric polygon head and a narrow suit body, blocky toy-like geometry, awkward original facial design, stiff posture, blurry textures, visible mesh gaps, stable two-color silhouette; tone: deadpan workplace satire
world: a flat fluorescent office wasteland with repeating desks and malformed documents
world_zh: 荧光灯扁平照亮、工位重复、文档变形的办公室荒原

script.action: 在荧光灯扁平照亮、工位重复、文档变形的办公室荒原中亮出老板主角与核心困境。
script.subtitle: 《老板来》

script.action: 主角试图熬过眼前这场荒谬危机，动作真诚而机械地崩坏。
script.subtitle: 大家再坚持一下。

script.action: 片名定格在最崩坏的一帧。
script.subtitle: 下一个，谁来？
